question: Do the loop mechanics survive severe lossy compression?

model.expert_types: mix of IQ1_S, IQ2_S, IQ2_XS, IQ2_XXS, IQ3_XXS, NVFP4 (11 tensors), a 2-bit Q2 type; the NVFP4 experts of IQ4_XS are largely requantized

generation.loop4: 4/6 clean (logic and colors no final answer)

interpretation: The trained 3-pass loop survives 2-bit experts: PPL +2.9% vs IQ4_XS and 6/6 on the probe.
The loop ordering is preserved: 2 and 4 passes are ~60% worse at both quants.
The quant gap is smallest at the trained 3 passes (2.9%) and larger off-schedule (6.4%/7.6%): the shipped schedule is the most quant-robust point; off-schedule passes amplify error.
The component hierarchy is unchanged: block-read queries (115x) and message gates (+117%) remain essential.
caveats: One 2-bit quant, one corpus, six short prompts; hard capability/long context untested.
The Q2 type mix is dynamic; '2-bit' is an average, not a uniform format.
PPL includes the padded output vocabulary; constant across the comparisons.
